title: Plynth build preview parts, version 1
description: build/preview/parts.json, written by the build with the preview parts: one FBX per floor and one per floor's roofs, with the same materials and images as build/building.fbx, so build/materials.json applies to them too. The app's 3D view loads them to hide roofs and upper floors; the plan overlay loads one floor's storey part. Parts are in floor order, the storey before the roof; a floor without roof sections has no roof part.

kind.description: storey: everything of the floor but its roofs (walls, fills, floors, ceilings, items, slab, stairs). roof: its roof sections.

file.description: A file name inside build/preview/, no folder.
